class.name: fr3_control/CartesianImpedanceController
class.description: Cartesian impedance controller for the FR3, forked from serl_franka_controllers. Clips the pose error before it becomes torque, so the contact force ceiling is stiffness x clip and is set independently of tracking stiffness. Adds an independent setpoint filter, absolute (non multiplying) nullspace gains, a nullspace re-anchor service, and publishers for the commanded setpoint and the pre-clip pose error.
